title: Christ the Healer: Claiming Your Inheritance on Good Friday
description: Join Pastor Chris Zehner as he delivers a powerful message of healing and hope on this Good Friday service. With a focus on Christ as our healer, Pastor Zehner shares the truth that it's God's will for us to be healed and that we can boldly claim this promise through faith. Don't miss this inspiring message that will challenge you to contend for real miracles in your life and in your church.
